summary_1line: Sweta avenges his brother Uttara, devastates Kaurava forces, and duels fiercely with Bhishma amid chaotic battlefield slaughter.

image_candidates.scene_text: Salya leaps from his chariot and slices off the trunk of Uttara’s elephant as the wounded beast screams and collapses.
Sweta stands in his chariot cutting seven warriors’ bows and darts from the sky with rapid arrows.
Bhishma and Sweta face each other amid dust and corpses, their chariots blazing with arrows as armies watch in dread.
